title: Nordstrom Rack Has 'Gorgeous' and 'Comfy' Knee-High Boots on Sale for Nearly 50% Off - NewsBreak
text:
By Olivia Bria ,
2 hours ago
Parade aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission.
Searching for the perfect autumn boot can be a tough feat — especially when many of them are priced at astronomical costs. Fortunately, Nordstrom Rack is consistently offering impressive discounts that can't be beat (like these suede Kenneth Cole shoes or fun graphic tee for just $13). This time, we spotted a deal on knee-high boots that you won't want to skip over.
The Aerosoles Micah Boot are 46% off at Nordstrom Rack, and are available in sizes 6 to 12, with some of the sizes already selling out. The gorgeous hues include black nappa pu and black fabric, which offer a leather or fabric feel. Both colorways are made of synthetic uppers, lining, and soles.
Aerosoles Micah Boot, $80 (was $149) at Nordstrom Rack The square-toed boot features a 2.75-inch block heel that gives you height while also boasting comfort. There's a simple side zipper closure that allows you to muscle in and out of them with ease, making the footwear ideal for those who want to be fashionable but are also constantly on-the-go.
Due to the classic and versatile coloring of the boots, they're an ideal investment for any wardrobe. Shoppers have described the shoe as "very stylish," citing them as ideal for a normal size calf. Although the average shows that the boots run true to size, some customers advise ordering half a size up (Nordstrom Rack has a solid return policy too, so you can always purchase two sizes if you're on the fence).
"First of all, I have no idea how these are not sold out!," one reviewer said. "The price is great. They are designer, they are a gorgeous color, and OMG are they comfortable. This is a must buy!!"
Shop more deals The biggest plus side? You can easily dress them up with a dress or skirt and tights, or dress them down with jeans or trousers. Nordstrom Rack offers free pickup at your local store, so you really have no excuse not to treat yourself. Take advantage of this incredible boot deal now!
